Summary: Missions is the organized work of taking the gospel across cultures and languages, from the apostle Paul's journeys to today's missionaries and translators. It has always involved more than preaching: learning languages, respecting cultures, planting churches, and serving communities. The history of missions includes both remarkable sacrifice and real failures, and modern missions tries to learn from both - partnering with local believers rather than replacing them.
